correctness.rationale: All displayed parameters are rational. The equilibrium residuals vanish exactly. At the homogeneous mode, the exact cubic coefficients satisfy the complete Routh–Hurwitz inequalities. At the finite mode, the coefficients remain positive while the Hurwitz determinant is exactly negative; Descartes’ rule excludes a positive real root, so the unstable roots form a complex-conjugate pair.
